title: Unifying Hearts
body:
Why did the companions of the Prophet* gather around him? They were not forced, they were not paid, they
were loved! People run to love. They hate bad characteristics and bad things. They like love, and that is what
the companions of the Prophet* were passing on. Allah filled the heart of Muhammad* with love and that is
what he gave to his followers. Without love there is no taste within faith. In every religion love is the first
power. When your heart has opened up to love for the Prophet* you will accept that he is a messenger. When
you love you will respect and you will follow. You cannot follow anyone without love.
- 01.01.1997
